summary.text: Ty Winter, a Republican, has represented Colorado House District 47 since January 9, 2023. The district's counties include Baca, Bent, Crowley, Huerfano, Kiowa, Las Animas, Otero, Prowers and Pueblo, and the legislature's site lists Winter as Assistant Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Winter co-operates a business and has served as president of the Chicosa Water Users Association, on the Holy Trinity Academy School Board, and on the board of the Las Animas County Fair.
